A Roman copper alloy coin: nummus of Gratian dating AD367-375. Reece period 19 reverse: GLORIA NOVI SAECVLI. Mint: Arles. Obverse: Diademed and cuirassed bust right. Obverse inscription: DN GRATIANVS [---]. Reverse: Emperor standing facing, holding shield and standard. Reverse inscription: [GLORIA NO]VI [SAECVLI]. Mint mark: -/-//CON. Dimensions: diameter: 19.34mm; weight: 2.22g
